name: two_state_VBM_CBM
notes: Hefei-NAMD SHPROP layout for a two-state basis (BMIN..BMAX spans 2 bands): column 0 is time in fs, column 1 is the running state energy written by the code, columns 2 and 3 are the two state populations. Verify the band character of each column against your own partial-charge analysis before using this map.
